entities.name: Vehicle A
entities.identification: A foreground open-wheel race car, with a dark blue tapered nose, two black front wheels with red sidewall stripes, and black suspension visible.

entities.name: gray paved racetrack
entities.identification: The broad gray paved road surface ahead of Vehicle A, curving to the right and bearing multiple dark tire marks.

entities.name: light blue sky
entities.identification: A large expanse of blue sky above the ground features, lighter in color near the horizon.

entities.name: red-and-white curb
entities.identification: A narrow strip composed of alternating red and white blocks, extending along the inner edge of the road's right-hand curve.

entities.name: grass beside the racetrack
entities.identification: Low green grass strips and lawns on both sides of the racetrack, with the area on the right curving along the bend.

entities.name: trees beside the racetrack
entities.identification: A cluster of trees behind the safety barrier, with green rounded or irregular crowns and some trunks visible.

entities.name: racetrack safety barrier
entities.identification: Continuous low, light-colored walls on both sides of the road, with a conspicuous orange wall section on the left.

entities.name: racetrack metal mesh fence
entities.identification: Mesh fencing around the outside of the road, supported by repeated vertical posts, with multiple horizontal lines visible above the top of the wall on the right.

entities.name: racetrack sign
entities.identification: A group of signs outside the road, including a blue-background advertising face on the left in the first frame and a green rectangular panel at the far end in the last frame.

entities.name: distant low-rise buildings
entities.identification: Light-colored low-rise building masses extending horizontally behind the safety barrier on the left in the first frame.

entities.name: red-and-white elevated mechanical arm
entities.identification: A slender white mechanical arm extending diagonally upward in the distance on the left in the first frame, with a red bent end.
